title: Architecture Context Metrics
description: Stable context-access metric contract used by architecture agent telemetry.

context_fetches.description: Number of context fetch operations (reads + queries).

useful_reads.description: Reads that contributed to the final answer.

navigation_reads.description: Reads used for navigation or discovery.

missing_context_detected.description: Whether missing architecture context was detected.

stale_context_detected.description: Whether stale architecture context was detected.

unsupported_inference_detected.description: Whether an inference exceeded available context.
